integrity: Original finite enumeration independently checked against the defining open-neighborhood predicate. No theorem extrapolated from finite cases; primary geometric proof included.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for PG(2,3) only; RED minimum follows earlier double blocking theory. Generalization to all projective-plane orders and absolute literature priority are not claimed.
title: Exact error-detecting open-location polynomials on the ternary projective-plane incidence graph
